Thanks for wanting to contribute to this list!

There are a few requirements for adding new entries:

- **GitHub repos must be at least 6 months old** (by first commit)
- Items should be unique
- Items in each section should be added in alphabetical order

The GitHub Action on this repo will automatically:
- Flag PRs that add a GitHub repo younger than 6 months
- Auto-close PRs where every added repo is younger than 6 months
- Flag list items added out of alphabetical order
